items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: I went with Kid Howard one time. And I had said I never was going out there no more. Out in Grand Isle.

ctx.x: Find out what things were really like in those days. Yeah.

So I got fired at that band because, you see, like we play a funeral and they finish, uh, like say here, you know. You go pay off where that, two, three blocks at that corner. Oh yeah. Uh, so we can buy the liquor, you see what I mean. They had no barroom, you know, that's paying off. They had to go without. Well, I wouldn't buy no liquor. I bought it once or twice and I told them I ain't doing it no more. Because the job wasn't paying that much. And if you had to take and go make four or five dollars, you know,…
